The organization employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

facts.claim: Medanta announced a 400‑bed multi‑specialty hospital in Varanasi with an investment of ₹550 crore.

facts.claim: Medanta opened a 550‑bed hospital in Noida.

In 2026 Medanta aims for around 3,000 operational beds and plans to reach 7,000 beds over the next 3‑4 years through new hospitals and brownfield expansions, including a 550‑bed Noida hospital, a 400‑bed Varanasi hospital, 500 additional beds across existing sites, and five greenfield projects adding roughly 2,700 beds.
facts.source_snippet: In 2026, Medanta continues its aggressive expansion journey with an estimated operational capacity of around 3,000 beds, while targeting 7,000 beds over the next 3‑4 years… ✅ 550‑bed super‑speciality hospital operational in Noida. ✅ 400‑bed multi‑speciality hospital announced in Varanasi… ✅ Plans to add 500 more beds across existing hospitals within the next year. ✅ Five greenfield projects expected to add nearly 2,700 beds…

facts.claim: Medanta reported a net profit of ₹1,195 crore in Q4 FY26, with total income for FY26 rising 19.6% year‑on‑year to ₹4,508 crore.
